extractions.label: hat_rack_deposited_item_bonuses
extractions.expression: (() => { const definitions = idleon.getAttr("ItemDefinitionsGET").h; const multiplier = idleon.callFunction("Gallery", "HatrackBonusMulti", 0, 0); return ["EquipmentHats108", "EquipmentHats76"].map(name => { const definition = definitions[name].h; const channels = []; for (let channel = 1; channel <= 2; channel++) { const effect = definition[`UQ${channel}txt`]; if (effect !== "0") channels.push({ effect, value: Number(definition[`UQ${channel}val`]) * multiplier }); } for (const effect of ["Weapon_Power", "STR", "AGI", "WIS", "LUK", "Defence"]) channels.push({ effect, value: Number(definition[effect]) * multiplier }); return { name, channels }; }); })()
extractions.description: Two genuine deposited hats from the native definitions. EquipmentHats108 covers both unique channels, Weapon Power, Defence, and zero primary attributes. EquipmentHats76 covers one unique channel and all four nonzero primary attributes. The native Hat Rack source multiplies each channel before addition. No website Item data or aggregate formula supplies these expectations.
